name: Ventures.eu
facts: Deep tech & AI, climate & agri, ICT
position: Ventures.eu is a Lisbon-based venture firm that picks standout European startups from Dealflow.eu's pipeline of 24,000+ mapped tech companies. Fund I invests from pre-seed to Series A in deep tech and AI, climate and agri-tech, and ICT including fintech and cybersecurity, and backs founders with corporate pilots, EU grants and operational support through a dedicated platform team.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager. Your edge is commercial validation, matching European deep-tech and AI startups with corporates, and that's exactly where founders need a product and revenue operator: turning pilots into paying customers.
summary: Ventures.eu helps founders prove their technology with corporate partners, and the step after a successful pilot is where many stall: packaging the product, pricing it and building the sales and CS motion to repeat it. I've spent nine years on that step, as a PM on data- and AI-heavy products and as the person wiring the CRM and onboarding behind a New York ad platform. Fund I is young, so beyond the companies named so far, I'd be glad to be an operator your platform team can introduce as the portfolio grows.

reasons.title: From pilot to repeatable revenue
reasons.body: Corporate pilots are your platform's strength. I build what comes next: discovery with the buyer, a product they can roll out, and pipeline and CS tooling to repeat the sale.

reasons.title: AI and data products, shipped
reasons.body: I've shipped LLM features with evaluation sets and guardrails, and ML features judged on F1. Spot Ship's AI chartering is that kind of product.

reasons.title: An operator for your platform team
reasons.body: You have a Head of Platform and operational support in IT, legal and finance. Product and RevOps would complete that offer, and I'm based in Lisbon.

vc_notes.thesis: AI and ICT (fintech, cybersecurity) overlap well; deep-tech hardware and climate less.
vc_notes.stage: Pre-seed to Series A: first product and first revenue engine.
vc_notes.platform: Head of Platform, corporate matchmaking for 300+ startups a year, EU-grant support.

companies.name: Bitsight
companies.desc: Cyber-risk ratings and third-party risk management.
companies.why: Security data sold through a large enterprise sales and CS organisation with a big Lisbon team: RevOps and data-product work.

companies.name: Spot Ship
companies.desc: SaaS that uses AI to cut ship chartering from days to hours for brokers, charterers and owners.
companies.why: AI marketplace SaaS for brokers: LLM and ML evaluation plus a broker-facing sales motion; Fund I's first deal, in January 2026.

method_notes: Fund I is recent; the companies scored are the ones Ventures.eu names publicly. Not scored for lack of a description: Marketsite.
matches_intro: Fund I is young: the 2 companies Ventures.eu names publicly
